summary: Define an evidence-backed CRUD contract for a synthetic service resource using external UUIDs and role-aware access.

requirements.statement: The API shall return an authorized, paginated service collection without internal identifiers.
acceptance_criteria: GET collection returns HTTP 200, documented pagination metadata, external UUIDs, and no internal numeric identifiers.
error_behavior: Invalid pagination values return the documented validation error without querying an unbounded result set.

requirements.statement: The API shall resolve an authorized service detail by external UUID.
acceptance_criteria: GET detail for an authorized existing UUID returns HTTP 200 and the documented public fields.
error_behavior: Unknown UUID returns the documented not-found response; a forbidden owner receives HTTP 403 without resource disclosure.

requirements.statement: The API shall validate and create one service resource atomically.
acceptance_criteria: POST valid synthetic data returns HTTP 201 with an external UUID and persists one auditable record.
error_behavior: Duplicate or invalid input returns the documented error and persists no partial record.

requirements.statement: The API shall replace an authorized service resource through PUT using complete validated input.
acceptance_criteria: PUT complete input returns HTTP 200 and persists the documented replacement exactly once.
error_behavior: Omitted required fields return the documented validation error and preserve the previous record.

requirements.statement: The API shall update only allowlisted fields through PATCH and reject stale versions.
acceptance_criteria: PATCH an allowlisted field and current version returns HTTP 200 while unrelated fields remain unchanged.
error_behavior: Forbidden fields or a stale version return the documented error without persistence changes.

requirements.statement: The API shall allow an authorized administrator to soft-delete a service resource and deny unauthorized roles.
acceptance_criteria: DELETE by an authorized administrator returns the documented success response, hides the resource from normal reads, and writes one audit event.
error_behavior: A viewer receives HTTP 403 with no state change; repeated deletion follows the documented idempotency contract.

in_scope: Synthetic service CRUD API and role-aware access
out_of_scope: Production data, UI implementation, live publication
non_goals: Defining BSI business policy from synthetic evidence

adaptive_sections.title: UI journey
adaptive_sections.rationale: This synthetic pilot validates an API-only change.
